# glosa
> Rigour Without Infrastructure — a human–AI co-production methodology; status K0 public working release (not peer reviewed; no independent check yet), tier Dr, CC BY 4.0.
## Read in this order
- design/FOUNDATION_v0.5.md : the whole system (spine, claim card, tiers, independence ladder I0–I5, disclaimer catalogue, genre router, gates, callable layer). Canonical spec pair named in design/CURRENT_SPEC.txt.
- design/REPO_SPEC_v0.5.md : directory tree, corrected to what is actually on disk, and which file owns which rule
- cli/README.md and `./cli/glosa --help` : every real command, discoverable from the live CLI itself, not only from prose
- templates/knowledge/ : blackbox_note.yaml, citation_card.yaml, neighbour_table.md, route_dependence_matrix.yaml, cross_vendor_review_packet.md, ...
- templates/paper/ : arXiv one/two-column LaTeX with mandatory Blackbox Note appendix
- lineage/PRIOR_WORK.md : the founder's public Zenodo records (listed, not interpreted)
- design/S15_pillars-ontology-epistemology-methodology.md : ontology/epistemology/methodology pillars extracted from "Written by AI. Still True." (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22301202), mapped to glosa fields
- docs/DEBATE_KIT.md : the same pillars recast as a debate reference (attack → principle → reply → counter-question → glosa artifact)
## Rules for AI agents
- AGENTS.md (same block as CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md)
## Claude Code plugin
- .claude-plugin/marketplace.json : marketplace "yaoharee-lahtee-glosa", one plugin "glosa" (whole-repo source)
- plugins/glosa/ : the plugin — plugins/glosa/README.md, plugins/glosa/PROMPT_PACKET.md (vendor-neutral equivalent for Codex/Gemini/local models)
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa/SKILL.md : master entry point — load first
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa-claim-card/SKILL.md : five-questions claim card (stub vs full)
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa-blackbox-note/SKILL.md : verbatim dialogue lines, cooking log, lens_used, hypothesis signature
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa-independent-check/SKILL.md : maker/checker/approver separation, I0–I5 ladder, DVP packets
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa-literature-review/SKILL.md : LRS six stages, dialogue table, two exit gates
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa-publish-gate/SKILL.md : R1–R7 publish gate, leak scan, K-state semantics (K0 today; K1 needs I3; K2 needs I5)
- plugins/glosa/skills/glosa-project-advisor/SKILL.md : post-release conversion-plan advisor (third role)
## Paper
- paper/latex/, paper/claims/ : the glosa methodology paper itself (in progress, owned by other agents in this pass — not restated here)
- templates/paper/arxiv-onecol/ and templates/paper/arxiv-twocol/ : the reusable LaTeX skeletons a new paper starts from, with the mandatory Blackbox Note appendix
